summary: Backend API regression and frontend smoke testing completed. Production frontend build passed, but all public API endpoints return 502 because the backend cannot authenticate to Supabase PostgreSQL; the resulting uncaught Axios error displays the React dev overlay and blocks later UI interactions.

critical.issue: Returns 502 because backend startup fails during init_db() with PostgreSQL password authentication failure.
All tested endpoints return 502 while the configured Supabase DATABASE_URL credentials are rejected; backend process is not serving a usable FastAPI application.

ui_bugs.issue: An uncaught Axios 502 error opens the React runtime-error overlay, which intercepts pointer events and prevents navigation to Data Management and subsequent controls.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend requests to the configured public backend receive 502, so KPIs, charts, project rows, filters, and project detail cannot be exercised.

action_items: Update DATABASE_URL with the reset Supabase PostgreSQL password and verify backend startup/init_db succeeds.
Add catch/error state handling to the Projects data-fetch effect so an API failure does not produce an uncaught runtime overlay or block the shell.
Re-run backend and full frontend integration tests after database credentials are corrected.
critical_code_review_comments: Calling init_db() at module import makes the entire API unavailable when PostgreSQL credentials are invalid; provide a startup failure path/health diagnosis while keeping the credential issue visible.
Projects useEffect calls api.get(...).then(...) without a catch, allowing a normal network/API failure to become an uncaught React runtime error.
seed_data_creation: None; backend could not connect to PostgreSQL and no data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend build passed. Home, Dashboard, and Project Explorer routes rendered and search accepted input. Backend credentials must be fixed before testing dashboard values, project rows/detail, PDF upload processing, or complete responsive navigation. Early-warning labeling is present but was not reached after the runtime overlay.
rca of the issue: Backend RCA: server.py imports and executes init_db(), which calls psycopg.connect(DATABASE_URL); Supabase rejects the configured password, so the Uvicorn child process crashes and ingress returns 502. Frontend RCA: Projects() has no rejection handler on its api.get promise. The 502 becomes an uncaught AxiosError, and the development runtime overlay iframe intercepts pointer events over the sidebar.
